limitations: Assistant source/evidence judgments can err; no independent human gold or exhaustive semantic proof.

The typed stock pack retrieves costs but omits nonnumeric duration facts; ordinary text arms already provide all requested evidence.

Only these eight frozen rendered packs are assessed; no claim of source-wide insufficiency, best-possible-baseline failure or a general coverage guarantee.
